 Recusal
 In the exercise of my official duties as a Member, I recused myself on September 17, 2024, from participating in any discussion or decision regarding the review and approval process of the marine occurrence M22A0258 in order to avoid any appearance of preferential treatment or any opportunity to further the private interest of my friend.
 On September 29, 2020, in the exercise of my official duties and in order to avoid any conflict of interest between my official functions and the private interests of a friend, I recused myself from the review and approval process of the Aviation Investigation Report A19A0055 involving Canadian Helicopters Offshore.
 Administrative Monetary Penalty
 Violation of subsection 22(5) of the Conflict of Interest Act:
Failure to disclose within 30 days a material change relating to assets.
